Block Parkour

A seriously tricky sky course! Jump between narrow blocks, watch for moving platforms, and reach the golden finish. Checkpoints save your progress.

WASD to move · Click the game and move the mouse to look · Space to jump · Hold Shift to sneak · Esc releases mouse
On touch: use the joystick, drag the view, and tap Jump or Sneak.

MOVE

On iPad, move with the joystick and swipe the game screen to look around. On computer, click the game once and move the mouse to look; press Esc to release it. Sneaking slows you down and keeps you from walking off an edge. ❄
